# observe_on_call_schedule (Resource)

An on-call schedule: rotation layers, later ones above earlier ones. Overrides are made in the dashboard and kept.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "observe_on_call_schedule" "primary" {
  name     = "Primary"
  timezone = "Europe/London"

  layers = [
    # Weekly rotation, handing off Mondays at 09:00
    {
      rotation_hours = 168
      handoff_time   = "09:00"
      starts_on      = "2027-01-04"
      user_ids       = ["USER_ID_ANA", "USER_ID_BEN"]
    },
    # Nights are covered by a separate daily rotation, above the weekly one
    {
      rotation_hours    = 24
      handoff_time      = "18:00"
      starts_on         = "2027-01-04"
      restriction_start = "18:00"
      restriction_end   = "08:00"
      user_ids          = ["USER_ID_CAM"]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `layers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layers))
- `name` (String)
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone

### Optional

- `handoff_emails` (Boolean) Email people when their shift starts
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider's `organization_id`
- `team_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID

<a id="nestedatt--layers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layers`

Required:

- `handoff_time` (String) H:i, schedule-local
- `rotation_hours` (Number) 24 daily, 168 weekly, 336 every two weeks, or any length
- `starts_on` (String) The first handoff's date
- `user_ids` (List of String) Members who are not viewers, in rotation order

Optional:

- `restriction_end` (String) H:i
- `restriction_start` (String) H:i: only on call from this time of day (with restriction_end; may wrap midnight)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<id>, or <id> when the provider sets organization_id
terraform import observe_on_call_schedule.example 01JCX4ZK7N2Q8V3W5Y6A9B0C1D/01JCX5A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9J0K1
```
